== Summary ==
The Friday-night team tournament: [[Scott Lingrell]] (right) plays [[Garrett Larson]] (left). The poster wrote: "Scott vs. deadbody the amount of experience between the two of them is incredible."

* '''Event:''' [[2023 World Championship]]
* '''Date posted:''' 2023-08-11
* '''Camera date:''' 2023-08-11 21:33 (from the original file name)
* '''Identification:''' The poster tagged both players by their Slack names (Scott and deadbody). [[Scott Lingrell]] (right): Slack user "Scott" is slingrell, and his face matches his [[:File:Scott Lingrell 2015 Hall of Fame.jpg|2015 Hall of Fame photo]]. [[Garrett Larson]] (left): his GEMP and Slack handle is deadbody, and his face matches his community card.
